items.item_text: Bachelors degree required in communications, public affairs, political science, public policy, journalism, government, business, or a related field.
Advanced degree preferred.

Minimum ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in advocacy, public affairs, government relations, political campaigns, issue campaigns, coalition management, stakeholder engagement, communications, or related disciplines.

Experience working in a trade association, corporate public affairs organization, political campaign, government office, advocacy organization, healthcare organization, or other regulated industry preferred.
Experience developing and executing advocacy, issue, electoral, public affairs, grassroots, grasstops, or stakeholder engagement campaigns.
Healthcare experience preferred but not required.
Experience building coalitions and engaging elected officials, policymakers, community leaders, trade associations, advocacy organizations, employers, and industry partners.
Experience leading teams, agencies, consultants, and cross-functional initiatives.
Advocacy & Campaign Strategy
Develop and lead integrated advocacy campaigns that advance Kaiser Permanentes legislative, regulatory, business, reputation, and stakeholder engagement priorities.
Design campaign strategies that combine coalition activation, communications, digital engagement, events, grassroots and grasstops outreach, thought leadership, and earned media strategies.
Partner with Government Relations leadership to identify strategic opportunities where advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and public affairs campaigns can help shape outcomes.
Develop campaign frameworks, activation plans, messaging architectures, stakeholder strategies, and implementation roadmaps.
Ensure campaigns align with enterprise priorities and are coordinated across national and market teams.
Government Relations Communications
Lead communications strategies that support Kaiser Permanentes government relations priorities at the federal, state, and local levels.

Partner closely with Federal Government Relations, State Affairs, Policy & Regulatory Affairs, Community Affairs, and Market Public Affairs leaders to develop messaging, communications materials, stakeholder engagement strategies, and advocacy resources.
Develop communications plans and supporting materials for legislative priorities, regulatory initiatives, policy campaigns, coalition activities, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
Create messaging frameworks, briefing materials, talking points, presentations, fact sheets, advocacy toolkits, campaign assets, and executive materials that support government relations objectives.
Ensure communications strategies are coordinated across enterprise and market government relations teams.
Support engagement with elected officials, policymakers, trade associations, coalition partners, advocacy organizations, and other external stakeholders.
Coalition Building & Stakeholder Engagement

Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholder organizations, trade associations, advocacy groups, employer organizations, community-based organizations, industry partners, and other influential constituencies.
Build and activate coalitions that advance Kaiser Permanentes strategic, legislative, regulatory, and business priorities.
Identify opportunities to leverage third-party validators and trusted voices to strengthen advocacy efforts and stakeholder engagement strategies.
Partner with State Affairs, Federal Government Relations, Community Affairs, and Market Public Affairs leaders to coordinate stakeholder outreach and engagement.
Strengthen Kaiser Permanentes visibility, influence, and credibility among key stakeholder audiences.
Stakeholder & Political Intelligence
Monitor and assess stakeholder, political, legislative, regulatory, advocacy, and industry trends that may impact Kaiser Permanentes priorities and operating environment.
Develop stakeholder maps, influence strategies, and engagement plans that help leaders understand the broader ecosystem shaping outcomes.
Provide strategic insights and recommendations to Government Relations leadership regarding emerging opportunities, risks, coalition dynamics, stakeholder sentiment, and external trends.
Identify opportunities to proactively engage stakeholders before issues become legislative, regulatory, or reputational challenges.
Digital Advocacy & Stakeholder Activation

Partner with communications, advocacy, and digital teams to develop modern engagement strategies that leverage digital platforms, social media, stakeholder mobilization, grassroots activation, and emerging engagement channels.
Build scalable approaches to stakeholder outreach, engagement, education, and activation.
Develop digital tools, resources, and campaign assets that support advocacy and engagement objectives.
Identify innovative approaches that increase participation, engagement, and influence among target audiences.
Market Integration & Execution
Partner with Market Public Affairs, State Affairs, Community Affairs, and Government Relations leaders to coordinate campaign execution and stakeholder engagement strategies across markets.
Develop enterprise campaign frameworks and activation tools that can be adapted locally while maintaining strategic consistency.
Ensure campaigns leverage both enterprise resources and local market relationships to maximize impact.
Share best practices, lessons learned, and successful approaches across markets and functions.
Campaign Measurement & Effectiveness
Develop measurement frameworks that assess campaign performance, stakeholder engagement, coalition activation, narrative penetration, digital engagement, and influence outcomes.
Establish reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into campaign effectiveness, stakeholder activity, engagement trends, and overall impact.
Evaluate campaign results and recommend improvements to strengthen future efforts.
Use data, insights, and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and organizational influence.
Strategic Counsel & Enterprise Partnership
Serve as a strategic advisor to Government Relations leadership on advocacy, coalition strategy, campaign opportunities, stakeholder engagement, and external activation.

Partner closely with State Affairs, Federal Government Relations, Policy & Regulatory Affairs, Community Affairs, External Communications, and business leaders to ensure coordinated engagement strategies.
Support enterprise leaders in understanding stakeholder landscapes, coalition opportunities, and engagement approaches.
Help ensure advocacy and stakeholder engagement efforts advance both policy objectives and broader organizational priorities.
Team Leadership & Capability Building
Lead and develop a high-performing advocacy and campaign team.
Build enterprise capabilities, playbooks, tools, governance models, and best practices that strengthen Kaiser Permanentes advocacy and campaign effectiveness.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and results.
Develop scalable approaches that enable effective campaign execution across markets and enterprise functions.
Demonstrated success influencing legislative, regulatory, stakeholder, reputational, policy, or business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex policy or business objectives into compelling campaigns and stakeholder engagement strategies.
